records.title: τ-Knowledge: Evaluating Conversational Agents over Unstructured Knowledge
records.reason: The benchmark evaluates search/retrieval configurations and notes that duration metrics depend on current API providers; its future-work efficiency direction is not an implemented inference optimization.

records.title: Soft Thinking: Unlocking the Reasoning Potential of LLMs in Continuous Concept Space
records.reason: Soft Thinking changes reasoning representation to continuous concept tokens, but the full text does not establish that it reduces inference compute, memory, latency, or token cost.

records.title: Alternating Multi-bit Quantization for Recurrent Neural Networks
records.reason: This is a multi-bit quantization method for recurrent neural networks, not current transformer/LLM inference. The potential quantization relevance is technically adjacent but transfer is uncertain.

records.title: Insertion-based Decoding with Automatically Inferred Generation Order
records.reason: Insertion-based decoding caches hidden states and permits inferred generation order, but the work is older machine translation and does not show relevance to modern autoregressive LLM serving.

records.title: Revisiting Parameter-Efficient Tuning: Are We Really There Yet?
records.reason: The paper surveys/evaluates parameter-efficient model tuning, a training adaptation topic rather than inference compute or serving.
